unresolved.description: "Ontology" is used both for a stratum of practice ("Ontology 0: the fuzzy layer") and for the bundle of commitments a stratum makes; the corpus never selects one reading.
"Existence", "truth" and "equality" are each redefined per layer; the paper records the drift but never supplies a cross-layer reconciliation beyond the morphism layer.

Named prior art (Coq, Lean, computer algebra systems, category theory, p-adic numbers, deep learning) is invoked without a single citation; no `candidates` could be recorded for the context-group requests.
No theory graph was supplied to this run, so no entry carries `grounds`; the bridge to `idea.theory_graph.json` remains to be filled.
"Meta-operator" is introduced by enumeration only; the six operators are named but none is given an operational semantics, which the paper itself lists as further work.
